headline: CSN Agrees to Sell Cement Division to China's Huaxin for R$12.7 Billion
summary: Companhia Siderúrgica Nacional agreed to sell its cement division exclusively to China's Huaxin for R$12.7 billion within a ten-day period, as the holding company works to reduce its R$42.1 billion debt.
why: Asset sales are closely monitored by investors to gauge balance sheet health and debt reduction progress for highly leveraged industrial conglomerates.

impacts.name: Companhia Siderurgica Nacional
impacts.why: The multi-billion asset sale directly impacts the company's valuation and debt profile.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Divestments of major business units to pay down substantial corporate debt improve solvency perceptions among investors.
